votes.motion: A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey, to adopt Resolution 23-54C, a resolution appointing Florence Reynolds to serve as a member of the South Valley Mosquito Abatement District, as a representative of Sandy City for a four year term commencing on January 1, 2024

A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Zach Robinson to convene a closed session in the Mayor's Conference Room to discuss the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual and pending litigation and to adjourn the Council meeting immediately following the closed session
